scientific_integrity: The measure entropy claim is proved by an exact periodic superword subsequence embedding and entropy coding bound; finite checks are illustrative rather than certificates for the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The logarithmic additive bound may not be sharp; no lower entropy asymptotic, ergodicity, uniqueness, or new frequency-positivity statement is claimed. The original article and an earlier factor-frequency analysis provide background. An unindexed general entropy inequality for rank-one words could affect priority.
title: Logarithmic Shannon block entropy for the Brik sequence
